meta.revenue_definition: Revenue = fines that have been PAID. Derived from Fine(amount, paid=True, paid_at) and surfaced on the dashboard as a 12-month monthly series.
meta.source_of_truth: Generated from EXISTING live data (real members, real books, real copies) by the seed_revenue_data command, so the mockup stays aligned with what the system already contains.

assumptions.repeat_offenders: Members with has_return_issues=true generate the bulk of monthly fines (weighted 55% in the generator).

summary.note: Figures above are the ACTUAL values produced by seed_revenue_data against the seeded dataset. Because fines are KES 5/day and the library has 49 members, monthly collected revenue is in the low hundreds of KES — realistic for this scale. To model a larger branch, increase member count or the per-day fine rate.
